user.title: Add an Airstage system
user.description: One system is one outdoor unit with its indoor units. Give it a name, then add the first indoor unit.

reconfigure.title: Indoor unit settings
reconfigure.description: The model selects the fan curve used for the heat estimate. The adapter does not report its unit's model, so pick it here; without a model, the unit gets no heat estimate. A room humidity sensor adds the moisture removed to the cooling estimate.

data.host: IP address of the Wi-Fi adapter
data.curve_slope: Custom fan curve: m³/h per rpm
data.curve_intercept: Custom fan curve: m³/h at 0 rpm
data.rated_airflow: Custom model: rated airflow at High (m³/h)
data.room_sensor: Room temperature sensor (for the short-cycle guard)

data_description.rated_airflow: From the same manual table as the fan curve. Lets the coil effectiveness rise at lower fan speeds; without it, it stays fixed.
data_description.room_sensor: Optional, experimental. A thermometer in the room, away from the airco and the sun, that reports at least every minute.

push_unavailable.title: Airstage push updates are off
push_unavailable.description: Home Assistant could not listen on port {port}, which the adapters send their updates to. Changes from the remote control show up within 10 seconds instead of at once. Make sure nothing else uses port {port}, and that Home Assistant uses host networking if it runs in Docker, then restart Home Assistant.

clock_lost.title: {unit}: the adapter lost its clock
clock_lost.description: The Wi-Fi adapter of {unit} lost its clock (after a power cut, for example), so its service values stay frozen. Home Assistant set the clock, but the values did not come back. Switching the adapter off and on again, or waiting for the Airstage cloud to set the clock, usually helps.

options.corrected_intake: Corrected intake (what the unit regulates on)

data_description.electricity_meter: Without one, electricity is estimated from the outdoor unit's current x 230 V.
data_description.coil_effectiveness: Default 0.85, at the High fan airflow. Lower fan speeds get a higher value (about 0.90 at Medium, 0.93 at Quiet). Scales every heat estimate.

compressor.name: Experimental: compressor starts
compressor.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep everything as it is.

data.power_sensor: Power sensor for the outdoor unit (W)
data.climate_temperature: Current temperature on the thermostat card

data_description.power_sensor: A power meter for the airco alone. Adds compressor start counts to the outdoor unit, to spot short-cycling.
data_description.compressor_on_w: Default 120 W. Above the off level, below the compressor's lowest running power (cooling can run below 200 W).
data_description.compressor_off_w: Default 80 W. Above what the meter reads while the compressor is off.
data_description.climate_temperature: The room temperature (default) or the corrected intake: the value the unit regulates on, updated every 5 minutes.

short_cycle_guard.name: Experimental: short-cycle guard
short_cycle_guard.description: Steers units that heat to start and stop the compressor less often. Off by default. If you use your own automation for the fan, switch it off first.

data.guard_fan: Fan while heating, instead of Auto
data.guard_hold: Delay restarts while the room is warm
data.guard_band: Restart when the room is this far below the setpoint

data_description.guard_fan: While a unit heats with its fan on Auto, use this speed instead. Low-medium kept a short-cycling unit running steadily. Other fan choices are left alone.
data_description.guard_hold: Needs the power sensor above and a room temperature sensor in the indoor unit's settings. After the compressor stops while the room is still warm, the unit's setpoint is lowered until the room has cooled, then put back.
data_description.guard_hold_offset: Default 0.5 °C. The thermostat card keeps showing your setpoint.
data_description.guard_max_hold: Default 45 minutes. After this the setpoint goes back regardless.

error.compressor_levels: The compressor's off level must be below its on level.
